quote: The target (canonical) IRI MAY: o Specify a relative IRI (see [RFC3986], Section 4.2).
anchorObserved: Section 3 'The Canonical Link Relation', page 2, bullet list 'The target (canonical) IRI MAY' (text view is one collapsed line)
reason: Re-fetched rfc-editor HTML still renders RFC 6596 as Category: Informational, April 2012, with Section 3 intact: the target IRI MUST be duplicative or a superset of the context content, and MAY be relative, self-referential, on a different hostname/domain, on a different scheme, or a superset. The teaches' second clause remains a valid reading: Section 3 imposes a content condition and Section 5 only RECOMMENDS verifying duplication, so a static declaration audit cannot establish duplicate/superset content. Scope (preferred-relation semantics, not Standards-Track conformance) matches the RFC's own Informational status disclaimer.
